title: Item Entry Timing and the Completion Percent: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Merchandising Note
content:
For a completion discount the registrant of a Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry redeems on her or his own order line (a purchase record of a registry item still in ordered status), the registry type's percent for the line is read from the item's most recent item entry, whether that entry added the item or changed its requested quantity:

1. when that entry falls fewer calendar days before the line's purchase date than the registry type's minimum days on the registry, no percent applies and the line receives no completion discount;
2. when that entry falls after the registry's event date and not fewer than those minimum days before the purchase date, the post-event item share — 50 percent — of the registry type's completion discount percent applies;
3. otherwise — the entry falls on or before the event date and not fewer than the minimum days before the purchase date — the registry type's completion discount percent applies.

## Figures by registry type

| Registry type | Minimum days on the registry | Completion discount percent (entry on or before the event date) | Post-event item share, 50 percent of it (entry after the event date) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Celebration Registry | 14 | 10 | 5 |
| Graduation Registry | 14 | 10 | 5 |
| Housewarming Registry | 14 | 15 | 7.5 |
| Baby Registry | 14 | 15 | 7.5 |
| Anniversary Registry | 14 | 15 | 7.5 |
| Wedding Registry | 30 | 20 | 10 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, Wedding Registry, event date 1 June)

| Most recent item entry | Purchase date | Calendar days between | Entry after the event date? | Percent for the line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 15 May | 20 July | 66 | no | 20 |
| 10 June | 10 July | 30 | yes | 10 |
| 11 June | 10 July | 29 | yes | none — no completion discount |
| 1 June | 1 July | 30 | no (on the event date) | 20 |

## Points of judgement

- Only the most recent item entry of the item counts; an earlier entry that added the item does not, once the requested quantity has been changed by a later entry.
- The minimum days are compared in calendar days from the entry date to the purchase date; exactly the minimum is enough.
